name: context-guard
description: Monitors session token usage in real time against Antigravity's ~256k Gemini 4 auto-compact threshold, displays non-intrusive inline alerts at 175k (68%) and 225k (88%), and guides strategic /compact checkpoints.
suggestedPrompts: Check current session token usage and remaining context budget
Show compaction history (manual /compact vs AUTO-COMPACT) for recent chats
Prepare a strategic handover summary before running /compact
